candidates.title: Silicon carbide fiber manufacturing: Cost and technology (Yilmaz et al., 2023)
candidates.notes: Composites Part B 2023. Covers SiC fiber manufacturing cost barriers directly: fibers >50% of finished composite cost, manufacturing 'prohibitively high' for cost-sensitive applications; crosslinking and raw material prep are high-cost bottlenecks. Confirms commercial availability limitation underpinning G-10 constraint. Accessible via OSTI biblio page.

candidates.title: Perspectives and challenges of ultra-high temperature ceramics for fusion plasma-facing applications (Lin et al., 2025)
candidates.notes: April 2025, Current Opinion in Solid State and Materials Science. Reviews UHTCs for fusion including high-temperature (>1000°C) neutron irradiation behavior. Plasma-facing rather than blanket structural focus, but covers temperature range and radiation challenges relevant to G-10. Accessible via OSTI biblio page.
